title: Concentrated Investments in Venture Funds
primary_theme: Concentrated LP portfolios and fund size as strategy output
founder_lessons: Make fund size the output of strategy, expertise, ownership, reserves, and fees rather than the starting input.
Concentrate capital when conviction is high so outperformance can matter to the portfolio.
Do not expand into geographies or sectors without a real local advantage and ability to compare opportunities.
Treat blockchain as a specialized diligence domain requiring technical and community-specific expertise.
notable_quotes: your fund size is your strategy.
When we have conviction, we do invest with conviction
